S.S. D.1451.

September 30, 40.

Acting Consul General for Poland,
Polish Legation,
26 Route Delastre.

Sir,

Stanislaw Adamski.

With reference to your letter No. Nr.A-3/Cn/4. dated
September 18, 1940, and further to my acknowledgment dated
September 23, 1940, I have the honour to forward herewith copy
of the Criminal record of the above named person.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Sd. K. M. Bourne.
Commissioner of Police.

FILE

(□ □) REG
DATE 2 / 10 / 40）

REPORT
Date December 30, 1940

Subject Confidential communication dated 18-9-40 from the Polish Legation,
Shanghai, concerning Stanislaw Adamski.

Made by J.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by J.I. Crawford.

Stanislaw Adamski alias S.S. Adamski, alias
KARFF alias DOLFF, Polish, age about 50, being the
subject of original record P.740, the particulars of which
are as follows:-

Offence | Sentence | Date
---|---|---
Trafficking in firearms. | 5 years penal servitude. | 21.1.20
| 7 years on confirmation of sentence | 10.3.20
Member of criminal gang. | Dismissed | 30.10.20
Shoplifting | Not guilty | 18.2.20
Fraud | Fined $200 or 100 days | 18.6.25
Concerned in manufacturing narcotic | Handed over to City District Court | 11.8.35
Fraud | Not guilty, to put up $20,000 shop security during the period of appeal, failing which accused to be detained in custody. | 4.5.37
| Accused to be released | 21.6.37
Successive Fraud | 1 year 6 months imprisonment. Accused, together with another ordered to jointly pay the sum of $5,000 for the civil action. | 11.12.38
Appeal Court | Appeal Dismissed | 20.6.39
| Released | 31.8.40

(Comm: of Police
Sir:
Information
R.G. Lark
D.C. (Sp. Br.))

a. Prokofiev
J. S. I.

D. C. ( Special Branch ).

INDEXED &
REGISTERED
DATE 30/ 9 /40

Shanghai, September 18-th. 1940.
26 Route Delastre

（批：R.）
（批：D. / 1451）
（批：24 9 40）

Confidential
============

Dear Sir,

The Consular Section of the Polish Legation requests you kindly
to inform it whether Mr. Stanislaw Adamski is noted in your files.

The Consular Section will be much obliged if you would furnish
it with full details that might be in your possession, concerning the above
mentioned.

（批：Not enclosed）
（批：$）

Enclosed please find a photograph of the above mentioned.

I beg to remain,

Dear Sir,

Your obedient servant,

（签名）

The Commissioner,

Shanghai Municipal Police,

S h a n g h a i .

September 23, 40.

Acting Consul General for Poland.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge the receipt
of your letter Nr.A-3/Ch/4 dated September 18, 1940,
and, in reply, have to state that the matter is receiving
attention.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Commissioner of Police.

JHS.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Special Branch No. 2 Station.
No. S. B. D. 1451.
Date July 2, 1930.
ate 18 - 7 - 30.

Subject (in full) Stanislav Adamsky.

Made by D.S. Faddeeff. Forwarded by Whcucra. K:4

With reference to the attached letter of June
20, 1930 from Hon. Secretary of the Polish Committee
in Shanghai re: Stanislav Adamsky, inquiries show
that he was charged at the Mixed Court with selling
arms and ammunition on 8-12-26 and was sentenced
to two years' imprisonment and expelled.

D. S. Faddeeff.
D. S.

D. C.
(C. & S. Branches)

P.S. The letter from the Polish
Committee of Shanghai, was first
opened by V.S.I. Robertson of the
Central Station who forwarded it
to D.I. Duncan, S.I.

Reg. Please draft reply to Polish
Cancelled Committee. The reply should be
marked "Secret and Confidential".
3/7/30.

S.I., Please notify the
Polish Committee verbally. Reg. file
The Hon. Secretary of the Polish Committee was notified
by me, verbally on the 8.7.30.
8-7-30. D.S. Faddeeff. 3:7:30

日期 1930年7月18日。

事由（全称）斯坦尼斯拉夫·阿达姆斯基。

由 D.S. 法德耶夫（Faddeeff）撰写。由 Whcucra. K:4 转呈。

参照所附1930年6月20日上海波兰委员会名誉秘书关于斯坦尼斯拉夫·阿达姆斯基的来信，经查，他于1926年12月8日在会审公廨被控出售武器弹药，并被判处两年监禁及驱逐出境。

D. S. 法德耶夫。
D. S.

副总监
（刑事及政治部）

附言：上海波兰委员会的来信首先由中央站的 V.S.I. 罗伯逊（Robertson）拆阅，随后转交给 S.I. 邓肯（Duncan）。

注册。请起草给波兰委员会的回复。回复应标记为“秘密且机密”。
1930年7月3日。

S.I.，请口头通知波兰委员会。归档文件
我已于1930年7月8日口头通知了波兰委员会的名誉秘书。
1930年7月8日。 D.S. 法德耶夫。 1930年7月3日

Shanghai, 20 June 1930

The Superintendent
of The Criminal Intelligence Dptmnt.
The Shanghai Municipal Police

Dear Sir,

We shall be much obliged to you for informatio
of
and records (if any of criminal nature) a polish subjec

and

上海，1930年6月20日

刑事情报处处长
上海公共租界工部局警务处

尊敬的先生：

如蒙提供波兰籍人士阿达姆斯基的情报及记录（如有任何犯罪性质的记录），我们将不胜感激，因为他打算返回波兰，为了获得护照，本委员会必须向波兰公使馆提供关于其行为的道德担保。

预先致谢，

此致
尊敬的先生，

您忠实的，

名誉秘书：
L. 马基耶维奇（Mackiewicz）
